verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Riskified's API endpoints (decide/submit/advise), chargeback automation, Beacon SDKs, notifications, and platform integrations (Shopify/Magento/SFCC), but contains no mention of an analyst-facing review queue, case dashboard, customer history view, or similar-case comparison tools. Fraud-prevention platforms commonly offer such analyst UIs, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence documents this capability.
